meta.title: Desktop Wallpaper
meta.description: Uses the current Windows desktop wallpaper or a custom image/video behind the whole DSH window, with opacity, mask, blur and sidebar-glass controls.

panel.title: Desktop Wallpaper
panel.subtitle: The current Windows wallpaper, a custom image or a looping video fills the whole window — sidebar, conversation and every column share one continuous background.
panel.unavailable: No readable desktop wallpaper was found.
panel.opacityHint: Lower values reveal more of the theme base color.
panel.maskHint: A full-window veil keeps labels readable over busy images.
panel.maskColorHint: Common open-source theme tints; light tints suit light themes, dark tints suit dark themes.
panel.blurHint: Softens only the image; the interface stays sharp.
panel.sidebarHint: Tint behind the left sidebar; lower is clearer.
panel.customHint: Choose a local image to replace the current Windows desktop wallpaper (max 48 MB).
panel.videoHint: Choose an MP4, WebM or Ogg clip (max 200 MB). Video and image wallpapers are mutually exclusive.
panel.customFailed: The custom wallpaper could not be applied.
panel.videoFailed: The video wallpaper could not be applied.
panel.coverage: One continuous layer behind the sidebar, conversation and right column.
panel.saved: Settings are saved in this browser.
panel.refreshFailed: The wallpaper could not be refreshed.
